symptom: An AutoX audit pseudo-type declared under a non-matching name — `StartedAt: autocreateddate` — silently becomes the fixed system member `CreatedDate` (declared name discarded), and binding that member in a widget then fails the build with **CE1613 "attribute … no longer exists"** (it's a system member, not a bindable attribute)
cause: The write path discards the identifier for AutoX types and `ValidateEntity` skipped them with no name check, so the rename + unbindable-member trap was silent. Sudoku findings #7
insight: Add **MDL022** (warning): when an AutoX attr's name (case-insensitive) ≠ its canonical member (`owner`/`ChangedBy`/`CreatedDate`/`ChangedDate`), warn that the name is discarded and the member isn't widget-bindable — use a plain attribute you set yourself if a widget must show it. Test `TestValidateEntityAutoMemberRename`
